div.p: In person in Singapore — in collaboration with TRE Thailand and Simba Stenqvist. A 2-hour workshop for the general public: discover what TRE™ is and how it can be beneficial for you as a body-based practice. Led by Isabelle Claus Teixeira and Simba Stenqvist.

div.p: This is an Introduction to TRE™ for the general public — a 2-hour workshop. Please note this in-person workshop does not include TRE™ personal sessions.

TRE™ (Tension, Stress & Trauma Releasing Exercises), developed by Dr. David Berceli, activates the body's natural neurogenic tremoring mechanism — a reflex that releases stored stress and trauma, builds resilience and promotes deep regulation.

In this workshop you will discover what TRE™ is and how it can be beneficial for you as a body-based practice. Should you want to go deeper, you can then continue your training with TRE™ Module 1, Module 2 and Module 3 to become a Certified Global TRE™ Provider — accredited to offer TRE™ to individuals and groups.
Each session is a separate, standalone date with the same content. All are in person in Singapore, 7:00–9:00PM Singapore time.
A full TRE™ session experience, guided by Global TRE™ Certifying Trainers.
This workshop does not include TRE™ personal sessions. Personal sessions can be purchased in addition, for S$180 per session.
For the general public — anybody interested to discover TRE™.

div.strong: Please do not register if any of these apply to you:

ul.li: Surgery or severe injury less than 8 weeks ago
PTSD and C-PTSD — we recommend private sessions instead

div.h2: Led by Isabelle Claus Teixeira & Simba Stenqvist

div.span: Global TRE™ Certifying Trainer · ICF PCC
div.p: Accredited by TRE™ for All under Dr. David Berceli's methodology — the highest level of qualification to certify new TRE™ Providers worldwide. Over 30 years of human development experience and somatic practice, training practitioners across Europe, Asia, the US and beyond.

div.span: Global TRE™ Certifying Trainer · Creator of Internal Alchemy
div.p: Somatic practitioner with more than 25 years of hands-on practice in bodywork, nervous system regulation and energetic healing — developed in close collaboration with Dr. David Berceli, founder of TRE™.
